title: Deterministic Observation
description: A single rule-based, threshold-triggered observation computed from video_benchmarks -- the structured, non-LLM evidence supplied to the strategy-synthesis prompt (prompts/shared/strategy/strategy-synthesis.v1.md). The LLM may phrase these in prose but must not invent, alter, or upgrade their confidence -- see docs/architecture/analytics-strategy-pipeline.md#deterministic-insight-rules.

rule_id.description: Stable identifier for the threshold rule that fired, e.g. 'ctr_below_median_healthy_retention'.

statement.description: Plain-language, cautious statement of the observation (e.g. 'CTR is 18% below the channel median at the 24h checkpoint').
